findings.claim_text: Compared against GB200/GB300 Blackwell systems on InferenceX, Jalapeño delivered 1.5-1.9x more AI work per watt at peak throughput and 1.7-3.6x lower end-to-end latency across GPT-OSS 120B, DeepSeek R1 670B, and Kimi K2.5 1T.
SemiAnalysis stated on August 25, 2026 that OpenAI's Jalapeño chip beats Vera Rubin's July results on Output Throughput per MW.
findings.contradicting_quote: Gavin Baker: 'the real comparison will be with Rubin Ultra given Rubin shipping today' — the 'beats Vera Rubin' result is against July 2026 MTP-enabled results, not a same-day head-to-head against the shipping Rubin or upcoming Rubin Ultra generation.

findings.claim_text: @jukan05 argued Jalapeño sources HBM4 almost exclusively from Samsung and therefore cannot scale to the same level as Rubin without relaxing its HBM4 speed requirement.
findings.contradicting_quote: SemiAnalysis hedges the supplier claim ('The HBM is likely provided by Samsung') and frames Jalapeño as a 'real high volume ASIC' with production 'gradually ramp over 2027', so the exclusivity-and-scale-cap reading is an analyst conclusion, not a confirmed constraint.
